records.title: Additively Manufactured Semi-Cryogenic Rocket Engine Injector Head and Regenerative Cooling Jacket for Reusable Launch Vehicles
records.description: Monolithic nickel-superalloy coaxial swirl injector matrix fabricated using selective laser melting for throttling reusable rocket propulsion stages.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. S. Somanath, S. Unnikrishnan Nair

records.title: Multi-Sensor Fusion Perception Architecture for Autonomous Navigation in Unstructured Road Environments Using 4D Imaging Radar and LiDAR
records.description: Real-time probabilistic sensor fusion framework with transformer-based 3D bounding box estimation designed for complex Indian traffic conditions.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. C. S. Shankar Ram, Sandeep Dharmadhikari
